entries.scope: Five-repository Secure Development Assurance Governance v0.1.3 field-test consolidation
entries.rationale: The central documentation must replace the previous partial field-test state with the verified five-project outcome while preserving the separate pending central preset decision.
entries.navigationImpact: The current-state section of the existing rollout tracker links the new canonical 5/5 roll-up; historical rollout evidence remains in place below it.
entries.languageStrategy: German first with English partner paragraphs in the same documents.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The report binds five merged project reports, their exact delivery pull requests, synchronized main commits, Bash and PowerShell parity, and project-native CI evidence.
entries.risk: Conflating five project-level preset recommendations with central preset acceptance could overstate approval; the report keeps the central decision pending until issue #4455 has an upstream outcome.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Preset, archive, project evidence, scope, decision state, review date, or github/spec-kit issue #4455 changes.

entries.rationale: The completed five-repository field-test consolidation adds a required phase slot and update-log entry to the repository statistics contract.
entries.navigationImpact: No new navigation path; the existing statistics ledger gains the v0.1.3 field-test consolidation phase.
entries.languageStrategy: The update log and generated text alternatives remain German first and English second.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: The canonical PowerShell renderer is invoked through the macOS Bash entrypoint and verified in check-only mode.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Another completed feature or implementation phase changes the ledger.
